framescale.title: FrameScale / Graphics
framescale.pending: Finishing changes… shaders will reload automatically.
framescale.native.tooltip: Photon TAAU: %s%%\n%s\nEstimated internal → output resolution. Auto-applies after slider release on Sodium 0.8.13; shader reload required.
framescale.auto.tooltip: Target %s FPS, floor %s%%\n%s\nChanges scale only under sustained stable load. Photon requires shader reload.
framescale.auto.target.tip: Target frame rate in auto mode. Default: 80. Consider VSync and FPS caps.
framescale.auto.floor.tip: Auto will not reduce scale below this limit. Default: 75%. Lower values may lose detail.
framescale.effects.name: Effect budget
framescale.effects.tip.original: Restore original effect values for this session; does not reset the shader pack.
framescale.effects.tip.shadows: Reduce shadow map to a declared value, not below 1536; preserve distance and filtering.
framescale.effects.tip.clouds: Reduce cloud raymarch steps moderately. Image detail may change.
framescale.effects.tip.reflections: Reduce SSR rays and steps. Reflections may change.
framescale.effects.tip.volumetrics: Reduce light shaft and LPV steps when available.
framescale.effects.tip.balanced: Clouds, SSR and volumetrics; preserve shadow map and render scale.
